limits: For red wine, Marselan: at most 10%
For white wine, Viognier: at least 30%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A Rhône Valley appellation in the Drôme. Its wines are made from Syrah, Grenache and Cinsault for red, and Grenache Blanc, Marsanne, Roussanne and Viognier for white.
